name: Vibe Kanban
tagline: Kanban board and workspace runner for parallel coding agents, with diff review and previews.
description: Vibe Kanban is a locally run web app started with npx that gives each agent task a branch, terminal, and dev server, with inline diff comments and a built-in browser preview. bloop, the company behind it, shut down in April 2026; the project is open source and its hosted cloud features are being retired.

pricing.notes: Free and open source under Apache 2.0; paid cloud plans were discontinued with bloop.
